segments.text: Buenas tardes, gracias por comunicarse con Red Maggy Internet.
Le hablo Laura. ¿Con quién tengo gusto?
Hola, buenas tardes. Con Andrés Mejía.
Mucho gusto, Andrés.
Para ayudarle, ¿me confirma por favor el número de cédula del titular?
Gracias. Ya tengo su cuenta. Cuénteme, ¿en qué le puedo ayudar?
Desde ayer el Internet se me cae a cada rato y hoy tengo que trabajar desde la casa. Entonces imagínese, ya estoy desesperado.
Entiendo perfectamente, Andrés. Es muy incómodo cuando uno depende de la conexión para trabajar.
Vamos a revisarlo juntos. ¿Me puede decir qué luces ve encendidas en el módem?
Hay una roja que dice luz.
Perfecto. Eso me ayuda mucho.
Esa luz indica que no está llegando señal por la fibra.
Revisé y en su sector hubo un daño en la red esta mañana. El equipo técnico ya lo está reparando.
Ah, ¿y eso cuánto se demora?

El tiempo estimado es de dos horas. Le voy a dejar registrado el caso con el número RM48213 y apenas se restablezca le llega un mensaje de texto. Además, por las horas sin servicio, le aplico un descuento proporcional en su próxima factura.
Bueno, eso sí está bien. Gracias.
Con mucho gusto.
Si en dos horas sigue la luz roja, nos llama con ese número de caso y le agendamos visita técnica sin costo.
¿Hay algo más en lo que le pueda ayudar?
No. Eso era todo.
Gracias por su paciencia, Andrés.
Que tenga una buena tarde.

segments.text: Good afternoon. Thank you for calling Red Magi Internet. This is Laura speaking. Who am I talking to?
Hi, good afternoon. This is Andres Mejia.
Nice to meet you, Andres. To help you, could you please confirm the account holder's ID number?
Thank you. I have your account. Tell me, how can I help you?
Since yesterday, my internet keeps dropping, and today I have to work from home.
So you can imagine I'm getting desperate.
I completely understand, Andres. It's really frustrating when you depend on the connection for work.
Let's check it together. Could you tell me which lights you see on the modem?
Uh, there's a red one that says LOS.
Perfect. That helps a lot.
That light means there's no signal coming through the fiber.
I checked, and there was a network outage in your area this morning.
Our technical team is already fixing it.
Oh, and how long will that take?
The estimated time is two hours. I'm logging a case with the number RM48213, and as soon as service is restored, you'll get a text message.
Also, for the hours without service, I'm applying a proportional discount to your next bill.
Okay. That's great. Thanks.
You're welcome.
If the light is still red in two hours, call us with that case number and we'll schedule a technician visit at no cost.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's all.
Thank you for your patience, Andres.
Have a good afternoon.

analysis.summary: The customer contacted support due to an internet outage affecting their work. The agent identified a network outage in the area, provided an estimated resolution time, logged a case, and offered a discount for the downtime. The agent also advised the customer to call back with the case number if the issue persisted after the estimated time.

criteria.comment: The agent greeted the customer, introduced herself and the company.

evidence.quote: Good afternoon. Thank you for calling Red Magi Internet. This is Laura speaking. Who am I talking to?

evidence.quote: Nice to meet you, Andres. To help you, could you please confirm the account holder's ID number?

criteria.comment: The agent showed empathy by acknowledging the customer's frustration and the impact on their work.

evidence.quote: I completely understand, Andres. It's really frustrating when you depend on the connection for work.

criteria.comment: The agent identified the cause of the issue (network outage), provided an estimated resolution time, offered a discount for the downtime, and gave clear instructions for further action if needed.

evidence.quote: That light means there's no signal coming through the fiber.
The estimated time is two hours. I'm logging a case with the number RM48213, and as soon as service is restored, you'll get a text message.

criteria.comment: The agent provided accurate information about the outage and resolution, and did not make any undue promises.

evidence.quote: Our technical team is already fixing it.
The estimated time is two hours.

criteria.comment: The agent summarized the next steps, provided a case number, and offered further assistance before ending the call.

evidence.quote: If the light is still red in two hours, call us with that case number and we'll schedule a technician visit at no cost.
Is there anything else I can help you with?

feedback: Ensure to always provide a case number for tracking purposes, even if the issue is resolved during the call.
When discussing technical issues, briefly explain what the error light indicates to the customer for better understanding.
Consider offering a proactive follow-up if the estimated resolution time passes without service restoration, in addition to the customer needing to call back.

segments.text: ¿Aló? ¿Marcela Rodríguez?
Sí. ¿Con quién hablo?
Le llamo de Créditos Tokio 3 por la deuda.
Usted tiene la cuota vencida hace 45 días.
Sí. Mire, yo sé. Lo que pasa es que me quedé sin trabajo el mes pasado y...
Señora, eso no es problema de nosotros.
La cuota es de 380 mil pesos y tiene que pagarla.
Yo quiero pagar, pero ahorita no tengo todo. ¿No hay forma de pagar por partes?
No, eso no se puede. Si no paga hoy mismo, mañana le embargamos la cuenta y la reportamos a centrales de riesgo.
¿Mañana? Pero eso no puede ser así de rápido. Pues así es. Usted verá.
Bueno, voy a ver qué consigo. Listo.

La cliente explica que se quedó sin trabajo y pregunta si puede pagar por partes, a lo que el asesor se niega y la amenaza con embargo y reporte a centrales de riesgo si no paga hoy. La cliente indica que verá qué consigue.

criteria.comment: El asesor no se presenta ni indica el nombre de la empresa al inicio de la llamada.
El asesor no verifica la identidad de la cliente antes de discutir la deuda.

evidence.quote: ¿Aló? ¿Marcela Rodríguez?

criteria.comment: El asesor no muestra empatía ante la situación de desempleo de la cliente y la interrumpe.

evidence.quote: Sí. Mire, yo sé. Lo que pasa es que me quedé sin trabajo el mes pasado y...
Señora, eso no es problema de nosotros.

criteria.comment: El asesor no ofrece alternativas de pago viables cuando la cliente las solicita y se niega a negociar.

evidence.quote: Yo quiero pagar, pero ahorita no tengo todo. ¿No hay forma de pagar por partes?
No, eso no se puede.

criteria.comment: El asesor amenaza a la cliente con embargo y reporte a centrales de riesgo al día siguiente si no paga, lo cual es una práctica coercitiva.

evidence.quote: Si no paga hoy mismo, mañana le embargamos la cuenta y la reportamos a centrales de riesgo.

criteria.comment: La llamada termina abruptamente sin un acuerdo claro o un siguiente paso definido por parte del asesor.

evidence.quote: Bueno, voy a ver qué consigo. Listo.

alerts.text: Amenaza de embargo y reporte a centrales de riesgo al día siguiente.
Falta de verificación de identidad antes de discutir datos de deuda.

feedback: Al inicio de la llamada, preséntate tú y la empresa para dar una mejor imagen.
Verifica siempre la identidad del cliente antes de hablar de su situación financiera o deudas.
Muestra empatía ante las dificultades del cliente y busca alternativas de pago flexibles en lugar de amenazar.
Asegúrate de acordar un siguiente paso concreto con el cliente antes de finalizar la llamada, como una fecha de pago o una revisión de opciones.

segments.text: Hello, Marcella Rodriguez.
Yes, who's calling?
I'm calling from Tokyo 3 Credit about the debt.
Your installment is 45 days overdue.
Yes, look, I know. The thing is, I lost my job last month, and...
Ma'am, that's not our problem.
The installment is 380,000 pesos, and you have to pay it.
I want to pay, but right now I don't have all of it.
Is there any way to pay in parts?
No, that's not possible.
If you don't pay today, tomorrow we'll freeze your bank account and report you to the credit bureaus.
Tomorrow?
But it can't be that fast.
Well, that's how it is. Your call.
OK, I'll see what I can get.
Fine.

analysis.summary: The agent from Tokyo 3 Credit called the customer regarding an overdue installment. The customer explained they lost their job and couldn't pay the full amount, asking for a payment plan. The agent denied this and threatened immediate bank account freezing and credit bureau reporting. The call ended with the customer stating they would see what they could get.

criteria.comment: The agent did not properly greet, state their name, or the company name at the beginning of the call.

evidence.quote: Hello, Marcella Rodriguez.

criteria.comment: The agent did not verify the customer's identity before discussing debt details.
The agent showed a complete lack of empathy, dismissing the customer's situation and using harsh language.

evidence.quote: Ma'am, that's not our problem.

criteria.comment: The agent did not offer any alternatives or solutions when the customer requested to pay in parts, and was dismissive of the customer's situation.

evidence.quote: No, that's not possible.
If you don't pay today, tomorrow we'll freeze your bank account and report you to the credit bureaus.

criteria.comment: The agent made an undue threat of immediate action (freezing bank account and reporting to credit bureaus) without exploring options or verifying identity.

evidence.quote: If you don't pay today, tomorrow we'll freeze your bank account and report you to the credit bureaus.

criteria.comment: The closing was abrupt and did not include a clear next step or summary of the conversation. The agent ended the call prematurely.

evidence.quote: Well, that's how it is. Your call.

alerts.text: Agent did not verify customer identity before discussing account details.
Agent made an undue threat of immediate action (freezing bank account and reporting to credit bureaus).
Agent displayed a lack of empathy and used dismissive language.

feedback: Always start calls with a proper greeting, including your name and company name, and verify the customer's identity before discussing any account-specific information.
Practice active listening and show empathy towards the customer's situation, even when discussing overdue payments. Avoid dismissive or harsh language.
When a customer cannot meet the full payment, explore and offer possible alternatives or payment arrangements instead of immediately resorting to threats.
Ensure calls are closed properly by summarizing the discussion and agreeing on clear next steps, rather than ending the call abruptly.

segments.text: Buenos días. Le habla Camila de Seguros Geofront. ¿Hablo con el señor Jorge Salazar?
Sí, con él.
Qué gusto saludarlo, don Jorge. Lo llamo porque usted cotizó en nuestra página un seguro para su carro, ¿cierto?
Ah, sí, la semana pasada.

Listo. Le cuento. Nuestro plan Todo Riesgo Plus cubre daños, hurto, responsabilidad civil, asistencia en carretera a las 24 horas, carro de reemplazo por 10 días, conductor elegido y también tiene descuento en talleres aliados.
Ajá. ¿Y eso cuánto vale?
Para su carro. Sale en 190 mil pesos mensuales.
Uy, eso está caro. Yo estoy pagando menos con otra aseguradora.
Ah, bueno, sí, entiendo. Es que el plan es muy completo.
Sí, me imagino. Bueno, déjeme lo pienso.
Claro que sí, don Jorge. Piénselo con calma.
Bueno, gracias.
A usted, que tenga un excelente día.

feedback: Al recibir una objeción de precio, intenta indagar más sobre qué aspectos del precio le parecen elevados al cliente o qué valor le da a la competencia.
Ofrece alternativas o beneficios adicionales que puedan justificar el precio o negociar un plan que se ajuste mejor al presupuesto del cliente.

Intenta concretar un siguiente paso, como agendar una nueva llamada para resolver dudas o enviar un resumen de la propuesta por correo electrónico, en lugar de solo dejarlo a la reflexión del cliente.

en.summary: The agent contacted the customer to follow up on a car insurance quote. The agent presented the 'Todo Riesgo Plus' plan and its benefits. The customer found the price too high and asked for time to think. The call ended without a clear next step or agreement.

criteria.comment: The agent verified the customer's identity by asking for his name.

evidence.quote: ¿Hablo con el señor Jorge Salazar?

criteria.comment: The agent showed some empathy but could have acknowledged the customer's concern about the price more directly.

evidence.quote: Ah, bueno, sí, entiendo. Es que el plan es muy completo.

criteria.comment: The agent presented the product details but did not effectively handle the customer's objection about the price or offer alternatives.

evidence.quote: Nuestro plan Todo Riesgo Plus cubre daños, hurto, responsabilidad civil, asistencia en carretera a las 24 horas, carro de reemplazo por 10 días, conductor eleg…

feedback: When a customer expresses concern about price, try to explore their needs further or offer different plan options that might better fit their budget.
To improve closing, suggest a concrete next step, such as scheduling a follow-up call to discuss their decision or offering to send more information.
Acknowledge the customer's objection more directly, for example, 'I understand your concern about the price, let's see if we can find a solution that works for you.'
Ensure that all sales calls aim to reach a decision or a clear next step, rather than leaving the customer to simply 'think about it'.

segments.text: Good morning. This is Camila from GeoFront Insurance. Am I speaking with Mr. Jorge Salazar?
Yes, speaking.
So nice to talk to you, Mr. Salazar. I'm calling because you requested a quote on our website for car insurance, right?

Oh yes, last week. Great. Let me tell you, our All-Risk Plus plan covers damage, theft, liability, 24-hour roadside assistance, a replacement car for 10 days, a designated driver service, and it also includes discounts at partner garages.
Uh-huh. And how much is that?
For your car, it comes to 190,000 pesos a month.
Whoa, that's expensive.
I'm paying less with another insurer.
Oh, well, yes, I understand. It's just that the plan is very complete.
Yeah, I imagine.
Well, let me think about it.
Of course, Mr. Salazar.
Take your time.
Okay, thanks.
Thank you.
Have a wonderful day.

analysis.summary: The agent initiated a call to follow up on a car insurance quote requested by the customer. The agent presented the 'All-Risk Plus' plan with its features and price. The customer found the price to be expensive compared to their current insurer and asked to think about it. The call ended without a clear next step or agreement.

criteria.comment: The agent greeted the customer, introduced herself and the company, and verified the customer's identity.

evidence.quote: Good morning. This is Camila from GeoFront Insurance. Am I speaking with Mr. Jorge Salazar?

criteria.comment: The agent verified the customer's identity at the beginning of the call.

evidence.quote: Am I speaking with Mr. Jorge Salazar?

criteria.comment: The agent acknowledged the customer's concern about the price but could have shown more understanding.

evidence.quote: Oh, well, yes, I understand. It's just that the plan is very complete.

criteria.comment: The agent presented the plan but did not offer alternatives or try to address the customer's concern about the price effectively.

evidence.quote: Let me tell you, our All-Risk Plus plan covers damage, theft, liability, 24-hour roadside assistance, a replacement car for 10 days, a designated driver servic…
For your car, it comes to 190,000 pesos a month.

criteria.comment: The agent maintained a professional and respectful tone throughout the call.

evidence.quote: Of course, Mr. Salazar.

criteria.comment: The call ended without a clear next step or agreement. The agent did not attempt to schedule a follow-up or confirm if the customer had any further questions.

evidence.quote: Okay, thanks.
Have a wonderful day.

feedback: When a customer expresses concern about price, try to explore if there are any other options or discounts that could be applied, or if a different plan might better suit their budget.

Ensure that after presenting a quote or proposal, you actively try to secure a next step, such as scheduling a follow-up call or sending additional information, rather than just ending the conversation.
Consider asking more probing questions about the customer's needs before presenting a specific plan to ensure it's the best fit and to potentially justify the cost.
When the customer states they need time to think, offer to send them the details via email or suggest a specific time for a follow-up call to discuss further.
